name: smwgraphics-soul-blazer-world-of-evil-space
title: Soul Blazer - World of Evil (Space)
description:
The space-like background seen in the final area of Soul Blazer, a cult classic video game made by Quintet. A good fit for space levels.

Bundled with this submission is a wave hdma code made by Donut, meant to replicate the effect seen in the source material. Insert it using UberASM Tool 2.1.
